text:
jordan: Quick check 16: iterating on the alerting hero panel layout. figma: https://figma.com/file/xyz. top padding feels too airy and the threshold helptext is vague. thoughts? maria: agree, loosened header looks spacious. can we reduce top padding by 8px on 1280px canvas? keith: +1. also change helptext from 'percentage of errors' to 'Percentage of requests failing over the past 5m'. clearer. sam: good copy. a11y: 'warning' color contrast is 3.1:1 now 14 fails AA for small text. need 4.5:1. jordan: noted. on notification channels: pill selector vs dropdown? pills show icons but use width. maria: prefer pills if we collapse extras to '+N' and keep icons. keith: if pills, ensure keyboard nav and role semantics. example patch: ```
``` sam: also show suppression state in preview (snoozed/muted). dimmed pill + :zzz: icon works. jordan: suppression tooltip copy: 'Temporarily suppress notifications from this channel.' shorter than current. maria: mobile nit: stepper too close to label. add 6px left margin under 480px. keith: move 'Preview notifications' inline with channels. users expect immediate preview. jordan: maybe inline preview icon button, advanced options under menu. aria-bot: preview modal must set aria-modal="true" and focus first interactive element; announce with aria-live polite. aria-bot: Accessibility check: modal should trap focus and include role="dialog" with accessible name. jordan: copy: SLO label 'Target' vs 'Target (%)'? maria: use 'Target' visually, add tooltip 'Target (%)' on hover for clarity. keith: increase token chip min-height to 28px to align baselines. maria: I'll update figma tonight and add pill + dropdown variants. sam: I'll run contrast pass and post palette fixes. keith: I'll prototype aria attr and keyboard nav in component branch. jordan: plan: maria updates figma EOD, keith PR a11y, sam fixes colors, I'll draft rollout doc. thanks :thumbsup:
